integrity: Exact bijective combinatorial proof, with independent finite exhaustive verification and a reproducible integer-arithmetic checker.
scientific_limitations: Only ordered pairs of idempotent full transformations; not arbitrary commuting pairs or higher-arity tuples. A relevant 2002 centralizer primary paper was only accessible in abstract; an independent audit has not been performed.
title: Product-rank enumeration of commuting idempotents in full transformation monoids
